record.question: What is important for the nurse to include in the postoperative care of the patient following tympanoplasty?
options: Encourage the patient to bathe next day after surgery
Instruct the patient to forcefully blow the nose
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Avoid flight travel. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 13, printed Q37. Avoiding flight travel is the keyed precaution. Option D actually says to forcefully blow the nose; the previous review misread it as “avoid” and wrongly treated it as another correct precaution.
